findings.summary: Observed and corrected during review: regression fixture failures; end-to-end evidence remains partial
Critical, reproduced Lua boundary: OTP aliases permit independent consumption
High, confirmed: production can enable fake OTP delivery
High, confirmed: archive download signs the wrong object
High, confirmed: payment webhook claims processing it never performs
Medium, confirmed: OTP rate-limit transport status is wrong
High, confirmed configuration inconsistency: API and worker resolve different DB settings
High, confirmed policy split: actual guard omits richer state gates
High, confirmed predicate: in-app notification listing includes other recipients
High, confirmed authority mismatch: document readers may create notifications
High, confirmed missing service binding: recipient decisions trust caller target
High, confirmed incomplete projection: heuristic resource detection and nested metadata
High, confirmed: revalidation ignores the asset URL and lacks review concurrency
High, confirmed: revalidation blocks shared evidence too broadly
High, confirmed model limitation: one document decision approves all linked requirements
High, confirmed: receipts and business mutation still have separate commits
Medium/high under load, confirmed architecture: nested transaction ownership
High, confirmed dispatch semantics: unknown outbox events are acknowledged
High, confirmed resource gap: scanner download has no byte ceiling
High, confirmed assurance gap: defect close can report success without a row
Medium, confirmed arithmetic/read-model defects
Medium, confirmed runtime-contract gaps
High operational risk, observed build mismatch
High release evidence gap: liveness is reported as readiness
High operational gap: restore drill does not restore evidence objects
Medium/high under load: long-running job/recovery acceptance remains unproved
Medium, confirmed incomplete import contract
Medium, confirmed maintenance and UX concentration
Risk, not established as active leak: legacy offline drafts are unpartitioned
High policy risk: mixed tenant-setting aliases can widen visible scope
High authority risk: archive read uses ordinary document.read
Risk: infrastructure declarations are not an operating service
